query:
SELECT 
  e.id,
  e.sessionSummary,
  e.createdByUserId,
  u.name as therapist_name,
  p.name as patient_name
FROM evolutions e
LEFT JOIN users u ON e.createdByUserId = u.id
LEFT JOIN patients p ON e.patientId = p.id
LIMIT 5;
